name: memova
description: Use Knowledge V5, run Memova workflows, and import selected content.

interface.shortDescription: Use Knowledge V5 and run private Memova workflows.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Memova through OAuth MCP for bounded Knowledge V5 retrieval, reviewed memory proposals, automation workflows, and explicit selected-content import. Imports are limited to content the user explicitly selects in the current request, show a bounded preview, and locally remove detected passwords, API keys, tokens, and private keys before upload. The plugin does not enumerate Codex history or install background collection. Existing V2/V3 vault tools remain available only for compatibility.
defaultPrompt: Search and use my Memova Knowledge V5.
